source.title: Firefighter Hand Anthropometry and Structural Glove Sizing: A New Perspective
source.definition: Appendix A, journal page 1375 (PDF page 17): width at the first proximal knuckle from the base of the finger, measured from a flat hand scan
source.population_limit: US firefighters measured in 2009-2012, not a universal male or individual fit guarantee

design_reason: Use the reported 24.4 mm male sample mean plus 0.8 mm each side, giving a 26 mm minimum opening. R10's larger-thumb allowance was rejected as too wide. The clearance is an agent-selected compact allowance, not a universal male average or measured comfort result.
implementation: Derive side-key spacing from the actual printed seat/floor inner reach and a quarter-millimetre grid. Check a full rectangular 26 mm opening above the rod crown against the final carrier and bought-part references. Retain compact inner load paths and the original interfaces.
